events.content:
I added a product image to each item in `app/ProductGallery.tsx`. It follows the pattern in `app/page.tsx`: the Next.js `Image` component from `next/image`, using `src={product.imageUrl}`, `alt={product.name}`, `width={300}` and `height={200}`. I also removed the TODO comments. The type check passes; I haven't run the app to look at it.

I left out the `priority` flag that the hero image in `page.tsx` uses. That flag is for the main image at the top of the page, and the gallery sits lower down, so its images are better loaded only as they scroll into view, which is the default.

There's no `public/` directory in the repo, so `/product-1.jpg` through `/product-3.jpg` (and `/hero-image.jpg`) won't load until those files are added.

content.text:
I added a product image to each item in `app/ProductGallery.tsx`. It follows the pattern in `app/page.tsx`: the Next.js `Image` component from `next/image`, using `src={product.imageUrl}`, `alt={product.name}`, `width={300}` and `height={200}`. I also removed the TODO comments. The type check passes; I haven't run the app to look at it.

I left out the `priority` flag that the hero image in `page.tsx` uses. That flag is for the main image at the top of the page, and the gallery sits lower down, so its images are better loaded only as they scroll into view, which is the default.

There's no `public/` directory in the repo, so `/product-1.jpg` through `/product-3.jpg` (and `/hero-image.jpg`) won't load until those files are added.
